dataset: ReplayLab CodeLab controlled browser challenge v1

metric_definitions.accuracy: Correct three-class verdicts / all completed cases.
metric_definitions.decisive_accuracy: Correct PASS or FAIL predictions / all PASS or FAIL predictions, including predictions on UNCERTAIN ground truth.
metric_definitions.false_certainty_rate: PASS or FAIL predictions on UNCERTAIN ground truth / all UNCERTAIN ground-truth cases.
metric_definitions.uncertainty_recall: UNCERTAIN predictions on UNCERTAIN ground truth / all UNCERTAIN ground-truth cases.
metric_definitions.decisive_misclassifications: PASS ground truth predicted FAIL plus FAIL ground truth predicted PASS; excludes abstentions and uncertain ground truth.
metric_definitions.p95: Nearest-rank 95th percentile of completed-case processing latency.

limitations: Twenty controlled CodeLab screenshots are a small authored challenge set, not a representative real-world benchmark.
Labels were fixed by the implementing coding agent before inference; they have not been independently reviewed by human annotators.
The CodeLab target is an interactive software simulation. No third-party extension is installed.
Real local OCR reads captured browser pixels; workflow rules use the reviewed mock demonstration template. No live Meta inference is measured.
These cases are stored separately from development observation fixtures, but share CodeLab and its expected labels. This is not a held-out application or blinded evaluation.

Latency covers uncached screenshot decode, local OCR, deterministic verification, and result construction; it excludes browser capture, transport, and cloud calls. The first sample can include OCR initialization.
Ambiguous and version-difference cases deliberately exercise abstention. A matching small-set score does not establish broad accuracy or calibrated confidence.
label_provenance: Coding-agent-authored challenge labels fixed in label-plan.json before capture and before OCR inference; not independent human annotation.
